title: Glood.AI pricing - Free forever tier plus display-volume billing from $19.99/month
clean_text: Glood.AI offers a 100% free forever plan including recently launched, recently viewed, trending, bestseller widgets, the visual editor, and unlimited usage. The Basic paid plan costs $19.99 per month, covering up to 10,000 widget displays, with overage charged at $1 per additional 1,000 displays beyond that threshold. Pricing scales primarily by widget display volume rather than order count or revenue percentage.
